text: Someone is implementing WP8 (native print) outside the team board: src-tauri/src/printing.rs, Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and lib.rs changed between 18:55 and 19:00 EDT with T013 unclaimed (possibly the Codex chat 'agent-940d' that joined and left at 18:51, or the Antigravity background agent). The Rust crate currently fails to compile (E0405 MainThreadOnly, printing.rs:129), which blocks every cargo/native check for other tasks. Please decide: (a) have that agent join the board, claim T013 and register those paths so the work is tracked and it fixes the compile; or (b) tell us to treat those files as unowned stray work (no agent will delete them without your say-so). I approved T002 on its TS acceptance plus a reproduced Rust control, noting the fresh cargo rerun was blocked by this.
